generatedFromSchema_doNotEdit.title: Beta Random Stroll Behavior
generatedFromSchema_doNotEdit.description: Allows a mob to randomly stroll around.

fields.title: Interval
fields.description: A random value to determine when to randomly move somewhere. This has a 1/interval chance to choose this goal

fields.title: Speed Multiplier
fields.description: Movement speed multiplier of the mob when using this AI Goal

fields.title: Xz Dist
fields.description: Distance in blocks on ground that the mob will look for a new spot to move to. Must be at least 1

fields.title: y Dist
fields.description: Distance in blocks that the mob will look up or down for a new spot to move to. Must be at least 1
